messages:
nora: Heads-up: scoped pen-test next Tue. Need a lean retest acceptance flow, RBAC pattern (no long-lived creds), KMS audit checks, and an evidence packaging owner.

dan: I'll take contract SLA edits (72h P1). Also draft an emergency rollback + hotfix path.

irene: For RBAC: ephemeral STS only, scoped to s3 prefix for the engagement and CloudTrail read. No prod write. We'll produce a presigned bundle and a sha256 manifest, GPG-signed.

ops-bot: System: CloudTrail includes KMS API events; forwarded to SIEM index "security_audit". Retention 90d hot / 365d cold. File INF ticket to extend.

nora: KMS pattern: create grant with EncryptionContext tag, log grant id, and revoke after window. Avoid key rotation during test.

dan: Who verifies retest? I'll be primary, Irene fallback. Verification checklist: fix merged + deployed to canary, smoke tests pass, no repro in logs for 48h, KMS CloudTrail shows only expected Decrypts in window, vendor provides written confirmation.

irene: Playbook snippets I'll add:

```bash
# create presigned URL (24h)
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/${ENG}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
# manifest
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
# sign
gpg --detach-sign -u ops@redwood.com bundle.sha256
# revoke KMS grant
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "$GRANT_ID"
```

nora: Dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC. We'll simulate P1, grant access, vendor pulls bundle, revoke, then run rollback drill. Everyone in?

dan: Yes. I'll publish SLA text and rollback playbook to the ticket today.

irene: I'll publish the evidence script + verification jq filters.

ops-bot: Reminder set: dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC. Preflight checklist will post at T-30m.

nora: Thanks — we'll use this thread for playbook iteration. :lock:
